terms.comment: Any burial place, from sepelīre, to bury.
Properly a mound of earth (see mound).

evidence: Vulg. Mt. 27.60: posuit illud in monumentō suō novō
terms.comment: The Vulgate’s word for the tomb of Christ.

phrases.latin: saeptum undique et vestītum vepribus et dūmētīs indāgāvī sepulcrum
phrases.english: I tracked down the tomb, fenced in on every side and overgrown with brambles and thickets

sources: Lewis & Short: sepulcrum · Lewis & Short: tumulus · Lewis & Short: monumentum
